notes: files[].version MUST be an integer. The app parses it as a number and only fetches a file when the remote integer is strictly greater than the one stored on device. A string reads as 0 and the file never updates again.
sequence is the intended intra-topic study order, ascending within (category, topic).
source_note is provenance for internal tracking and is stripped before final delivery.
match: right may contain unused distractors so that no pairing falls out by elimination.
rubric element shape: { dimension, weight, looks_for[] }; weights sum to exactly 100.
open questions carry no explanation field.
